DELIVERY_PROBLEM.what_it_represents: Issues with package delivery, tracking, late deliveries, lost packages
DELIVERY_PROBLEM.notes: Well-defined intent. May need sub-intents: LATE_DELIVERY, MISSING_DELIVERY, TRACKING_ISSUE, CARRIER_ISSUE

ORDER_ISSUE.what_it_represents: Order status, modifying/canceling orders, order numbers
ORDER_ISSUE.notes: Mixed with delivery. ORDER_STATUS is distinct from ORDER_MODIFICATION/CANCELLATION

TECHNICAL_ISSUE.what_it_represents: App/website problems, streaming issues, device problems
TECHNICAL_ISSUE.notes: APP_ISSUE dominates (70%). DEVICE_ISSUE and VIDEO_STREAMING are distinct sub-intents

PRODUCT_ISSUE.what_it_represents: Product quality, wrong item, damaged, defective
PRODUCT_ISSUE.notes: Clear customer problem: received defective/wrong product

ACCOUNT_ISSUE.notes: Clear intent. May overlap with login-related TECHNICAL

PRIME_MEMBERSHIP.what_it_represents: Prime subscription, renewal, cancellation, Prime benefits
PRIME_MEMBERSHIP.notes: Often a context modifier, not primary intent. Customer problem is usually delivery/refund, not Prime itself.

CUSTOMER_SERVICE_QUALITY.what_it_represents: Complaints about service quality, no response, rudeness
CUSTOMER_SERVICE_QUALITY.notes: Not a customer intent - this is sentiment/escalation signal for routing decisions

CONTACT_REQUEST.what_it_represents: Customer asking to be called/emailed/DMed, requesting to speak to someone
CONTACT_REQUEST.notes: Not a customer intent - describes how customer wants to be supported. Should be used for escalation, not intent classification.

PAYMENT_ISSUE.what_it_represents: Billing problems, credit card issues, gift cards

REFUND.what_it_represents: Money refund requests, refund status, reimbursement
REFUND.notes: Clear customer problem. Often overlaps with RETURN but distinct ask.

RETURN_EXCHANGE.notes: Clear customer problem. Customer wants to return/exchange item.
